title: Canonical affinization isomorphism on an affine principal open
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-pc-scheme] that is quasi-separated, meaning that the intersection of any two affine open subschemes is quasi-compact. Put $C=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and let $f\in C$. Let $X_f=\{x\in X:f_x\in\mathcal O_{X,x}^{\times}\}$ and assume $X_f$ is affine. Let $j:X\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ be the canonical morphism corresponding to $\mathrm{id}_C$ [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $j^{-1}(D(f))=X_f$, and the induced morphism $j_f:X_f\to D(f)$ is an isomorphism of schemes. Under the canonical identification $\Gamma(D(f),\mathcal O)=C_f$, where $C_f$ is the localization at the powers of $f$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away], its section homomorphism is the ring isomorphism $C_f\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(X_f,\mathcal O_X)$ sending $a/f^n$ to $a|_{X_f}/(f|_{X_f})^n$.

source.place: Tag 01P8, lemma-invert-f-affine, statement and proof (the canonical morphism on an affine principal open)

proof.text: Apply Scheme.toSpecΓ_preimage_basicOpen to identify the inverse image of D(f) with X_f. Mathlib isIso_ΓSpec_adjunction_unit_app_basicOpen, the qcqs section-localization theorem (Tag 01P7), says that the section map X.toSpecΓ.app D(f) is an isomorphism. The extra restriction in appLE is induced by the displayed equality of opens, hence is an isomorphism. Scheme.Hom.resLE_app_top conjugates this map by the two canonical top-section identifications, proving that the restricted morphism g has an isomorphism on global sections.

source.place: Tag 01P7, lemma-invert-f-sections; Tag 01P8, lemma-invert-f-affine. Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/QuasiSeparated.lean, isIso_ΓSpec_adjunction_unit_app_basicOpen; Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Restrict.lean, resLE_app_top.

proof.text: The source X_f is affine by hypothesis and D(f) is affine by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-section-vanishing-prime]. Apply [lem-sc-affine-global-sections-iso]: concretely arrowIsoSpecΓOfIsAffine identifies g with Spec.map g.appTop, which is an isomorphism since g.appTop is one. This proves the required IsIso clause.

Scheme.toSpecAway is g followed by basicOpenIsoSpecAway, hence is an isomorphism. Scheme.awayToBasicOpen is its global-section map preceded by the inverse of ΓSpecIso, so it too is an isomorphism. Convert asIso of this actual canonical ring map to a ring equivalence; its forward homomorphism is definitionally awayToBasicOpen. For a and n, multiply the proposed fraction formula by the unit (f restricted to X_f)^n. Scheme.awayToBasicOpen_algebraMap identifies images of global elements with restrictions, and IsLocalization.mk'_spec [def-weil-ring-localization-away] identifies the left side with the restriction of a. On the right use Ring.inverse_mul_cancel and the power law. Cancel only the restricted unit, never f in the original ring; this includes zero-divisors, nilpotent f and the empty scheme.

source.place: Tag 01P7, canonical localization map, and Tag 01P8; WeilConjectures/Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/AffineScheme.lean, toSpecAway, awayToBasicOpen and awayToBasicOpen_algebraMap.

The item has the same qcqs and X_f-affine hypotheses as 01P8, plus a true explicit fraction-map clause, which the parent lem-a1-quasi-affine-open-affinization-square uses. Step 1: lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme with rho=id_C gives j^{-1}D(f)=X_f. lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-section-vanishing-prime(b) on Spec C gives D(f) affine with sections C_f. Restriction compatibility and preservation of inverses give the fraction formula. Step 2: lem-sc-p1-invertible-section-localization (01PW(2)) with L=F=O_X and s=fT, so N=C[T,T^-1]. Degree-zero fractions are aT^k/(fT)^k, and their equality relation is exactly that of def-weil-ring-localization-away. X_s=X_f because the stalk is local. The bijection is step 1's ring map, so it is a ring isomorphism. Step 3: lem-sc-affine-global-sections-iso applies because both opens are affine. Edge cases checked: X empty, f=0 or nilpotent, f a unit, f a zero divisor. No duplicate: rg -L for 01P7/01P8/isLocalization_basicOpen_of_qcqs finds only this item and its parent. No cycle, no SGA. lean.statement: theorem affine_principal_affinization_isomorphism (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (f : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hf : IsAffineOpen (X.basicOpen f)) : X.toSpecΓ ⁻¹ᵁ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = X.basicOpen f ∧ IsIso (X.toSpecΓ.resLE (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) (X.basicOpen f) (X.toSpecΓ_preimage_basicOpen f).ge) ∧ ∃ e : Localization.Away f ≃+* Γ((X.basicOpen f).toScheme, ⊤), e.toRingHom = (X.awayToBasicOpen f).hom ∧ ∀ (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ), e (IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.Away f) a (Submonoid.pow f n)) = (X.basicOpen f).ι.appTop a * Ring.inverse ((X.basicOpen f).ι.appTop f) ^ n
